theme.title: Warriors, Cavs and Raptors

questions.prompt: LeBron James scored the most points ever in a Finals loss in Game 1 of 2018. How many?

questions.prompt: Golden State opened the second half of Game 2 of the 2019 Finals with how many unanswered points?
